title: Customer complaints after software implementation
accepted_explanation: The new software created service failures.
observations: Customer complaints rose during the month of a software implementation.
A seasonal volume peak occurred in the same month.
participant_claims: Employees report both software usability problems and unusually high workload.
researcher_interpretations: Technology, capacity, and demand explanations cannot yet be separated.
assumptions: Because the software was new, it caused the observed deterioration.
